ThingDef.label: economic hp serum
ThingDef.description:
A hermetically sealed canister containing HP serum, a substance filled with specialized mechanites that upon contact with any wound repair them in seconds. This economic version uses cheap materials at cost of a low effectiveness, cannot heal scars, lost limbs or diseases. HP Serum can be loaded inside some weapons 

<color=#cbff52>Gameplay effect:</color> 

Barely strong enough to heal properly, weapons using this serum heal exactly their healing base value

ThingDef.label: standard hp serum
ThingDef.description:
A hermetically sealed canister containing HP serum, a substance filled with specialized mechanites that upon contact with any wound repair wounds in seconds. This substance was made with standard protocols that allow to perform a correct and effective healing, cannot heal scars, lost limbs or diseases. Canisters can be loaded inside some weapons 

<color=#cbff52>Gameplay effect:</color> 

Proper crafting methods allow weapons using this serum to increase their base healing value by X2.5

ThingDef.label: experimental hp serum
ThingDef.description:
A hermetically sealed canister containing HP serum, a substance filled with specialized mechanites that upon contact with any wound repair wounds in seconds. This experimental strain of mechanites is capable of healing a higher quantity of wounds, however, it still cannot heal scars, lost limbs or diseases but can do some miracles if applied correctly. Canisters can be loaded inside some weapons 

<color=#cbff52>Gameplay effect:</color> 

Due to its Glitterworld grade creation, weapons using this serum increase their heals by X6 their base healing value.
